rv.q: Robison directs this comic drama, set in 1930, with brisk action and smart dialogue by her cast of six.
What is a critic to do when a production's many excellent parts just don't gel?
Despite its comic trappings, “The Dover Road” is ultimately a journey to a sad and lonely place.

cn.t: A.A. Milne's 1921 comedy of manners has its moments but doesn't quite come together, with critics noting the production's excellent individual elements fail to gel into a cohesive whole.
